items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: And this Booker Ray is just this recent name.

ctx.x: Where did that name come from?

Storyville. They originated all from a lot of the pioneers, road setters, other sporting houses downtown. It was called Storyville then. And this Booker Ray is just this recent name. But that was called, in those years, 40, 50 years ago, was called Storyville. It's called Storyville.
Do they have any other names for it then?
